title: Equilibrium Learning in Unbounded Stochastic Games with Gaussian Transitions
abstract: arXiv:2610.16149v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning equilibria from data is difficult when several decision makers interact indefinitely and the system state has no prescribed bounds. We examine discounted general-sum stochastic games with compact action sets and an unknown nonlinear drift observed through Gaussian transition noise. The proposed procedure uses a single uninterrupted trajectory to update Gaussian-process models of the drift and to solve successively refined finite games. We prove a perturbation result showing that stability of equilibrium selection, together with uniform KL accuracy of Gaussian transition models, is sufficient for regional uniform convergence of the induced values and approximate Nash behavior in the original game. The region specifies where the guarantees are evaluated; strategies and dynamics continue to act on the entire Euclidean state space. translated_title: 具有高斯转移的无界随机博弈中的均衡学习
translated_abstract: 当多个决策者无限期地交互且系统状态没有规定边界时，从数据中学习均衡是十分困难的。我们研究了具有紧动作集、其未知非线性漂移通过高斯转移噪声进行观测的折扣一般和随机博弈。所提出的方法利用单条不间断的轨迹来更新漂移的高斯过程模型，并求解逐步精化的有限博弈。我们证明了一个摄动结果，表明均衡选择的稳定性，加上高斯转移模型的一致KL精度，足以保证原博弈中诱导值和近似纳什行为实现区域上的一致收敛。该区域规定了保证被评估的位置；而策略与动力学仍继续作用于整个欧几里得状态空间。对于GP估计器，同时置信界可产生由后验不确定性控制的收敛速率……
tldr: 该论文针对状态空间无界、转移噪声为高斯的随机博弈，提出利用单条连续轨迹更新高斯过程漂移模型并求解逐步精化的有限博弈来学习均衡，并证明了均衡选择稳定性与一致KL精度足以保证诱导值和近似纳什行为的区域一致收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes learning equilibria in unbounded stochastic games with Gaussian transition noise by updating Gaussian-process drift models from a single continuous trajectory and solving successively refined finite games, proving that equilibrium selection stability combined with uniform KL accuracy suffices for regional uniform convergence of induced values and approximate Nash behavior.
